sections.heading: Overview
sections.html:
Aethyr is the standalone server executable, the editor plugin components and the documentation. It is licensed under a proprietary End User License Agreement (the EULA), not an open source license. Licensor: Doug Fessler. The EULA text was last updated 2026-07-11.

The full, binding text is LICENSE.md, inside every download (Plugins/Aethyr/LICENSE.md once unzipped). This page is a plain-language summary. If it and that file differ, the file governs.

By downloading, installing, activating or using the software you agree to the EULA. If you don't agree, don't install, activate or use it. The EULA says you may request a refund under the applicable storefront policy.

A Seat (Section 0) is an authorization for one identified individual. The grant is subject to the EULA and to payment of the applicable fee.

  • Personal: use by one individual, or by an entity with under USD $100,000 in annual revenue or funding, on up to 2 machines that individual controls.
  • Professional: use within one organization, up to the number of named Seats in your order. Each Seat may activate up to the number of machines stated in your order. Any Pro exclusive capabilities, if and when offered, also need a valid Professional license.

Concurrent or shared use by more individuals than purchased Seats needs additional Seats. You may use the software to develop commercial products, and output you create with the software belongs to you.

The Licensor recommends version control and the software's built-in backup feature. See Security & Privacy for what the backup feature does.

sections.heading: License keys and license data (Sections 2 and 7)
sections.html:
This is what the EULA text says. Section 2 says the software validates a license key and may periodically contact the Licensor's licensing service to confirm entitlement and refresh a locally stored license file. It says the software is designed to keep working offline for a grace period of 14 days between successful validations. You may not share, publish, resell or circumvent license keys or the activation mechanism. The Licensor may revoke a key upon refund, chargeback or material breach.

Section 7 says activation and validation may send a license key, a hashed machine identifier, a coarse timestamp, and product and version information to the licensing service. The stated purpose is entitlement verification and abuse prevention. The data is kept for the life of the license. A separate Privacy Policy, linked from the storefront listing at the time of purchase, applies. For EU buyers that standalone policy governs, not just this clause.

  • Term (12): the EULA lasts until terminated. It ends automatically if you breach it, and you must then stop using the software and destroy all copies. Sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 9 and 11 survive termination.

  • Entire agreement (14): the EULA is the whole agreement about the software. If a provision is unenforceable, the rest stays in effect.

sections.heading: Third-party notices
sections.html:
The Aethyr editor plugin (the modules under Source/) contains only first-party code and depends on Unreal Engine modules. The MCP server executable vendors these libraries, as listed in NOTICE.md, which carries their license texts:

  • nlohmann/json, MIT. JSON-RPC wire format, server only.
  • fmt, MIT. String formatting, server only.
  • BLAKE3, CC0-1.0 (or Apache-2.0). Checksum of the editor's asset gather cache, server only.
  • doctest, MIT. Unit tests, server only, not shipped.

sections.heading: Brand & attribution (website guidance)
sections.html:
This is brand guidance for this website and its brand assets. It is not a term of the software license above. To keep the credit recognisable, present Aethyr consistently wherever it appears.

Required credit

When you reuse this website's content or brand assets, reproduce this line verbatim in acknowledgements, such as an About screen, a README, a credits roll, or documentation:

Aethyr MCP — created by Doug Fessler  https://aethyr.gg

Wordmark

The name is set in Fraunces, uppercase, with wide letter-spacing: Aethyr. Keep it one word with a capital A; do not translate, abbreviate, or rename it.

  • Do keep the credit legible and the link intact.
  • Do place the wordmark on a dark ground for contrast.
  • Don't recolour the wordmark into a gradient, add glow or effects, or re-letterspace it.
  • Don't imply endorsement or partnership beyond the credit itself.

sections.heading: Colour & type
sections.html:
Aethyr is a void ground with four accents. Each accent carries a meaning in the product UI — reuse the coding if you extend it.

  • Cerulean #2fb9ff — primary accent · read
  • Magenta #ff2bd6 — write
  • Violet #9b6bff — batch
  • Ember #ff8a4c — safety & caution
  • Void #0b0c1a — background
  • Ink #e8ecff — text

Typefaces

  • Fraunces — display & wordmark
  • Chakra Petch — labels, UI, small caps
  • Sora — body text
  • JetBrains Mono — code & data
